content:
We are now just one day away from Apple’s "Surprise and Shine" event, where between six and nine new products are expected to be unveiled.

The iPhone Ultra folding model will be the main focus of the event, but among the expected announcements, which one are you personally most looking forward to…?

At the very least, we expect Apple to announce six new products tomorrow, but if all the rumours are true, there could be as many as nine.

The iPhone Ultra is almost certain to make the headlines. It is the first folding iPhone in Apple’s history, coming roughly seven years after Samsung pioneered this type of device. However, the starting price is expected to exceed US$2,000, with high-spec versions possibly reaching US$3,000, so it certainly won’t be the best-selling product.

So among the expected and possible announcements, which one are you personally most looking forward to? After watching our video presentation, don’t forget to take part in the poll and share your views in the comments section.
